segments.exact:
Atlas rollback rehearsals run monthly from now on. A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.
segments.note: Sets a recurring cadence — a directive establishing a standing practice, justified by the following assertive sentence within the same quoted turn.
Restates the decision as a recorded key-decision bullet; unified voice, no distinct principal marker needed since actor already carries it.
Records ownership assignment as part of the key-decisions summary.
